title: Move Factory credentials, embedding, deployment bundles and CI
description:
SPEC 12 Phase 4 item 7. Move the Factory's credential ladder, embedded payload, deployment bundles and CI into ticfac.

Last of the seven because it is the one that makes the move irreversible: until the deploy path lives here, the old one can still deploy. Related open work: ticks s70 (configure Cloudflare release secrets for the deploy-cloud workflow) and zkq (required-tk-commands cannot express the tk subcommands tk itself invokes for the sandbox image build) - settle both or record why they do not block.

The credential ownership split from Phase 3 (9hu, ~/.ticfacrc) is the precedent: say which credentials are ticfac's and which remain the operator's, and do not let a secret become a thing that only works on one machine.
